analysis:
Examined all five primary analyses and independently checked the three replayed patches. provider-ci-build/action.yml head 64, 91, 146, 154, 160 and 181 gates repository, build and Metal cache restore/save on CI_ACTIONS_CACHE; provider-release-build/action.yml head 120, 165, 185, 263, 275 and 392 applies the same gate, retaining qualification conditions. ci-master.yml head 80–89 and 230–239 exports the flag before cache operations; restore/save conditions consume it. This reconciles the composite-action propagation question for the replayed callers. The patches do not disable build or qualification steps.

ci-master.yml head 111–136 and 258–283 adds pre-checkout rejection of symlinks, hooks and selected executable/include Git configuration, retaining integrity checks and credential-free checkout. This reduces existing exposure; incomplete sanitization or suppressed parser/traversal errors do not independently establish a new regression over BASE.

The other analyses cover provider-tests.yml, desktop.yml, landing.yml, provider-release-cache.yml and build documentation, but their exact source is omitted from this replay (35 of 38 reviewed units). Their claims of consistent gates and unchanged tests cannot be independently verified here. No supported finding follows from that omission.

Relevant assets are build identity/qualification and availability (A-011, A-017, A-018; T-013, T-034, T-054). No supplied patch changes serving authorization, attestation verification, plaintext handling, billing or privileged execution. Actions build caches are distinct from T-041's inference KV cache.

Remaining material review: verify omitted workflow changes and the runner-side contract described at docs/developer/build.md:658–680. Checking DARKBLOOM_CACHE_URL presence does not itself prove cache redirection, authentication or branch/PR isolation. Those external controls are unverified, not observed missing controls. No concrete regression is established by the supplied evidence; this is not a full artifact-integrity audit.
